title: Libre2 Patched App + xDrip + Follower - calibrations
body:
Hello,

 I am using xDrip (latest stable version on both phones).
Also using LibreLink patched app as source for xDrip.
Second phone is follower of first.

When I enter calibration, it works in my phone, but follower phone shows different BG. (it does not use calibration, but instead shows values from LibreLink patch app)

comments.body: Settings -> InterApp Settings -> Accept Calibrations (From Other Apps) is set to On?
